families.title: the player's travel: ground, air, fluids, climbing, flight, falls and its own move
collision: block shapes, steps, partial blocks, the world border, pistons and shulker lids
effects: status effects, attributes, enchantments and the blocks a player stands in or on
entities: what pushes or carries the player, projectiles, the server's moving entities, portals and impulses
excluded: the fishing hook's bite and its rod's retrieve: the bite's timing and pulls are the server's random (catchingFish's timers, syncronizedRandom's pulls), which no recording holds, and the retrieve is the rod's use; a hook is compared up to either (docs/limitations.md, Excluded on purpose)

families.title: vehicles: boats, ridden mobs and minecarts, ridden and not
fluids: water and lava contact, currents, drag, eyes, waterlogging, flow blockers and fluid jumps
projectiles: arrows, tridents, thrown items, fireballs, wind charges, rockets, bullets and the fishing hook
excluded: the fishing hook's bite and its rod's retrieve: the bite's timing and pulls are the server's random (catchingFish's timers, syncronizedRandom's pulls), which no recording holds, and the retrieve is the rod's use; a hook is compared up to either (docs/limitations.md, Excluded on purpose)

families.title: attributes: gravity, scale, step height, speeds, movement efficiencies, jump strength, fall damage and burning
poses: sneaking and crouching, crawling, swimming, gliding, sleeping, dying, a passenger's, under a ceiling and a shulker lid
tick ordering: every phase of the client's tick and of its vehicle's, in vanilla's order, each compared where it ends
prediction: the adapter's client decisions and motion, the client's moving entities, the bot
